notes: ὅσα takes all things that whole, headed on all: the quantitative relative's own lexeme is what all realizes, as rule 104 heads ὅσα → how much soever on much and ὅσαι → how many soever on many, and things is the generic completion. The competing head on things under rule 77 is named in the unit's note.
συναγαγόντες keeps the preverb particle together inside its own unit under rule 106, discontinuously under rule 15, no competing prepositional phrase standing.
ὁ before θεός is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23, the ASV writing God with no determiner.
